variants.name: 墨黑朱铜
variants.prompt: Edit the supplied game logo following this latest corrective feedback. Exact text ONLY "逆转五丈原" in simplified Chinese. The previous gold surface looks cheap and the BLACK OUTLINE IS TOO HEAVY. CRITICAL: REMOVE THE THICK BLACK BORDER ENTIRELY, REMOVE BEVELS, REMOVE EXTRUSION, REMOVE ALL DROP SHADOWS. Change material language from 3D gold plaque to sophisticated FLAT HAND-BRUSHED PIGMENT and restrained matte mineral sheen. Make the interiors of the first two characters 逆转 MOSTLY BLACK, not golden letters outlined in black. Their darkness must be actual letter fill. First two characters 70-85 percent charcoal-black ink with subtle colored material variation and sparse highlights. Last three 五丈原 lighter, with varied aged pale gold, warm grey and copper pigment, NOT uniform bright yellow metal. Preserve strong readable original five-character brush wordmark and overall horizontal arrangement, but make 逆转 visibly MORE AIRY AND FLUID: leaner main strokes, more open counters, elegant tapered curves, long fine dry-brush terminals, a natural lift in the final stroke, no huge bulky underline. 五丈原 remains fuller and steadier. The two groups must feel like one coherent designed title. Correct readable character skeletons, no missing strokes. Bespoke project lettering guided only by supplied artwork, do not use named fonts or existing commercial logos or artists. Sophisticated historical Chinese narrative game, tactile ink and mineral pigment, microscopic restrained texture, not grit or hammered gold. Restrained purposeful color transitions INSIDE STROKES only. All lettering has crisp clean thin natural silhouette edges, NO ADDED OUTLINE of any color. True transparent background, one isolated logo, generous margin around entire artwork, wide landscape canvas about 3:1. No mockup, no dark rectangular backing, no paper backdrop, no scene, no additional characters, slogans, English, stamps, watermark, swords, dragons, particles or light rays. Palette 01: 逆转 in rich neutral ink-black softly varying to warm charcoal, with a trace of muted burgundy and copper-red pigment brushing into the long lower return stroke. The red is a restrained dark cinnabar accent, not a red letter body. 五丈原 has layered muted champagne-gold, warm stone-grey and aged copper, moving subtly from cooler pale upper stroke surfaces to warm copper at selected tips. Appearance like elegant brush ink with softly applied bronze dust, matte and nuanced, neither metallic embossed nor flat yellow. Overall 逆转 notably darker than 五丈原, handsome black / pale gold / copper / dark cinnabar harmony.
